title: Google Opal Explained in 20 Minutes! in Hindi
column7: I’ll show you how to use Google Opal
column9: to build AI agents and automations using just natural language prompts — no coding required! Google Opal is a No Code platform currently in the experimental phase. In Google Opal
column10: you just need to input a prompt and your mini AI apps will be generated. Google Opal take cares about your app's backend and frontend. In this video I gave the walkthrough of this platform. Also
column11: I have created one mini app(gem) using Google Opal."
